title: Book Three · Chapter 22: The Chair by the Mirror
story:
The following Saturday, Ronan sends another letter to Leo.

This one tells him Kai's name. It also has a small drawing of a paper tray. Ronan puts the envelope in the post box before the shops get busy.

On the way home, he sees Kai through a wide window.

Kai sits in a high chair. A white cloth covers his shoulders. A man stands behind him with scissors.

Ronan stops outside the barber's shop.

Kai sees him in the mirror. He tries to turn his head.

“Keep still,” the barber says.

Kai looks straight ahead again. One of his friends sits on a bench near the door.

The boy waves Ronan inside.

“He can't play football now.”

“He can watch,” Ronan says.

Kai looks at them in the mirror.

“You are both very funny.”

The barber lifts some hair with his comb. He cuts along his fingers. Small dark pieces fall onto the white cloth.

Ronan sits at the other end of the bench. His own hair keeps falling near his eyes. He pushes it back.

“Your turn next?” Kai's friend asks.

“Maybe next week. I need to ask Mum.”

“Mine too. I'm only waiting.”

Kai looks at the boy in the mirror.

“You said we were going together.”

“We came together.”

“To get our hair cut.”

“I came to watch yours.”

Ronan laughs. The barber smiles but keeps his hand steady.

When he finishes, he holds a second mirror behind Kai's head. Kai looks at the back of his hair.

“All right?”

Kai nods. The barber brushes the loose hair from his neck and takes away the cloth.

Kai pays. Outside, he runs a hand over his head.

“Cold now.”

His friend puts up his own collar.

“You need a hat.”

“I have a paper tray,” Kai says.

“Not in the rain.”

They walk toward the next corner. Kai and his friend want to visit another boy. They have known him since their old school.

Ronan has work to finish at home. At the crossing, he stops.

“See you on Monday.”

Kai turns. “Will you know me?”

Ronan studies his short hair.

“Bring the ball.”

Kai laughs and goes with his friend.

At home, Mum looks up from a pair of trousers. Her green and grey bag hangs on the back of her chair. It is finished now.

Ronan points to his hair.

“Can I have it cut next week?”

She looks carefully at the part near his eyes.

“Yes. I was going to ask you.”

“Kai had his done today.”

“Then we can see if you need the same barber.”

“I need the same chair. It looked comfortable.”
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

barber＝理发师；mirror＝镜子；comb＝梳子；collar＝衣领。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan这次给Leo寄的信新增了哪位朋友的信息？
2. Kai的朋友有没有跟他一起剪头发？剪完后，Kai是否一直陪着Ronan？

## 读句子

**A white cloth covers his shoulders.**

拆开看：A white cloth / covers / his shoulders.

一块白布／盖住／他的肩膀。
